from glom import *
from boltons.funcutils import FunctionBuilder,inspect_formatargspec
from boltons.setutils import IndexedSet,complement
from boltons.dictutils import OneToOne
import warnings,inspect
with warnings.catch_warnings():
 warnings.simplefilter('error')
 def f(a=1,*args:int,b=2,**kw:str)->int: pass
 fb=FunctionBuilder.from_func(f);assert fb.get_defaults_dict()=={'a':1,'b':2};fb.get_sig_str();fb.get_func()
 assert inspect_formatargspec(**inspect.getfullargspec(f)._asdict())=='(a=1, *args: int, b=2, **kw: str) -> int'
assert glom({'a':2},Fill(('literal',T['a'],Auto('a'))))==('literal',2,2)
assert glom({'a':2},(Let(x='a'),S.x))==2
assert glom([0,1,2,3,4],Iter().dropwhile(lambda x:x<1).filter(lambda x:x%2).chunked(2).all())==[[1,3]]
assert glom([[1,2],[3]],Iter().flatten().all())==[1,2,3]
assert glom([0,1,2],Iter().first())==1
assert glom({'a':{'b':1}},Inspect('a.b',echo=False,recursive=True))==1
assert set([1,2])-IndexedSet([2,3])==IndexedSet([1])
assert set([1,2])-complement({2,3})=={2}
a=IndexedSet([1,2,3]);a.difference_update([1],[2]);assert a==IndexedSet([3])
a=OneToOne([('a',1),('b',1)]);a.update((x for x in [('c',1)]));assert list(a)==['a','b','c']
print('targeted compatibility checks passed')
